customer_message.body:
Hello

As I understand it: I received a rent increase; The figures look too high, but I cannot find the previous calculation; I am worried about the deadline; this is my fullest current account.

Regarding “possibly miscalculated rent increase”, my first account covers: the prior reference rate baseline remains unresolved; for the request “check the form and calculation and explain next steps”: I have included everything currently available to me; on “possibly miscalculated rent increase”, I need a concise assessment first; also unresolved: the exact receipt time; this defines the scope of my report.

My question is: check the form and calculation and explain next steps; in particular, I need clarity about the exact receipt time and whether the records support an initial assessment.

I became aware of the problem on 08 August 2025.

Thank you for clarifying; I need a clear reply about the prior reference rate baseline; I need that answer before proceeding.

Best regards
